paragraphs.source_en: “Darrow of Lykos, by the power entrusted in me by the Compact, I hereby find you guilty of conspiracy to incite acts of terror.” I stare directly into the holoCam’s optic lens, knowing how many countless souls watch me now. How many countless eyes will watch me long after I have gone. “I find you guilty of mass murder upon the citizens of Mars.” I barely listen to her. My heart thunders in my chest. Rattling the fingers of my left hand. Pushing up into my throat. This is it. The end swarming toward me. “I find you guilty of murder.” This moment, this fragment of time is my life in summary. It is my shout into the void. “And I find you guilty of treason against your Society….”

units.source_en: I stare directly into the holoCam’s optic lens, knowing how many countless souls watch me now.
How many countless eyes will watch me long after I have gone.
“I find you guilty of mass murder upon the citizens of Mars.”
I barely listen to her.
My heart thunders in my chest.
Rattling the fingers of my left hand.
Pushing up into my throat.
This is it.
The end swarming toward me.
“I find you guilty of murder.”
This moment, this fragment of time is my life in summary.
It is my shout into the void.
“And I find you guilty of treason against your Society….”
But I want no shout.

paragraphs.source_en: Let that be for Roque. Let that be for the Golds. Give me something more. Something they cannot understand. Give me the rage of my people. The wrath of all people in bondage. As the Sovereign recites her sentence, as the Jackal waits to deliver it, as Mustang kneels on the ground, as Cassius watches me from among the Praetorians and Knights, waiting, and as Aja sees me look to the tall blond knight, she steps forward in trepidation because she knows something is wrong, I throw my head back and I howl.

paragraphs.source_en: The Sovereign nods to the Jackal to execute the sentence. He presses the barrel to the back of my head and he squeezes the trigger. The gun kicks in his hand. Fire spits, scorching my scalp. Deafening sound ringing through my right ear. But I do not fall. No bullet carves through my head. Smoke swirls out of the barrel. And as the Jackal looks down at the gun, he knows.
